name: Mega-NeRF Spatial Partitioning
definition: Decomposes a scene into spatial cells with centroids to train separate MLP submodules in parallel, reducing memory and training time for large-scale scenes.
summary: Mega-NeRF Spatial Partitioning decomposes large 3D scenes into spatial cells, each trained with a separate MLP in parallel to overcome monolithic NeRF bottlenecks, distinguishing itself by assigning distinct weights to fixed regions rather than using shared models or sparse voxels.
